title: UAAP: Ateneo's Enot wins emotional gold; UP continues to pace women's division
summary: Ateneo's Ivo Enot swam to an emotional gold medal as the Blue Eagles continued to lead the way in the men's division of the UAAP Season 89 swimming championships on Wednesday.
